name: rivet
title: Rivet
description: An ironmonger's wall of small drawers: every product is a wooden drawer front with a typed manila card in a brass holder, its category on a white enamel plate above and a brass cup pull below, in dark-stained oak by default and scrubbed pine in the light scheme.

tokens.--font-slab: the heavy slab of the shop's name, page headings, headings in page text, news titles and the lettering on the enamel plates
tokens.--font-type: the typewriter face of everything else: the cards (a product's name included), body text, the menu and the small labels
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of capitals: the menu, enamel plates, status stamps, dates, back links and shop card headings
tokens.--color-grain: the grooves between the boards of the page background, and the grain and lower edge of each drawer front
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop's name and the menu; also the focus ring around a drawer
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, quotations, list markers, page numbers and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the underline of links on the page background, and the focus ring there
tokens.--color-carcass: the cabinet carcass: the joints between drawers, the line around the cabinet, the hollow under each cup pull and the edge of photographs
tokens.--color-drawer: the drawer fronts and the outer frame of the cabinet
tokens.--color-drawer-lip: the lighter top edge of each drawer front
tokens.--color-brass: brass, mid tone: the sides of card frames, the cup pulls, the double rules, the rule under table headings and the bar beside a quotation
tokens.--color-brass-light: brass, lit: the top edge of card frames and the highlight and lip of the cup pulls
tokens.--color-brass-dark: brass, shaded: the bottom edge and keyline of card frames, the shaded side of the pulls, the screws, the thin rules in lists and tables, and the menu marker on hover
tokens.--color-marker: the brass bar under the current menu item, deep enough to stand out from the wall in both schemes
tokens.--color-card: the manila card: product cards, the shop card, the skip link and selected text
tokens.--color-card-ink: the typed text on cards and the shop card, their focus rings, and the fill of the sold-out stamp
tokens.--color-card-faint: lighter ink on a card: the unit, the rows of dots, and the words above the phone and e-mail
tokens.--color-soldout: the card of a sold-out product, and the lettering of its stamp
tokens.--color-enamel: the white enamel plate that carries the category
tokens.--color-enamel-ink: the lettering and keyline on an enamel plate
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--shadow-card: the shadow a brass frame throws on the card inside it
tokens.--shadow-cast: the shadow that plates, card frames, cup pulls, the cabinet and the shop card throw on the wood
tokens.--drawer: widest a drawer front starts at: a row takes as many as fit, then stretches them to fill the cabinet
tokens.--joint: the gap between drawer fronts, and the carcass edge around them
tokens.--frame: thickness of the brass frame around a card; the shop card's frame is a little thicker
tokens.--pull: width of the cup pull; its height follows, and the product page uses a larger one
tokens.--board: width of one board of the page background
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of drawers, cards, plates, stamps and code; the cabinet is rounded twice as much
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside a drawer and a card
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, and the gutter between columns
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the shop card and at the foot of the page
